label: Diagram 6.4
caption: Diagram 6.4 Minimum space requirements for floor-mounted charge point location
description: Diagram 6.4, titled "Minimum space requirements for floor-mounted charge point location", shows two elevations. The left part, labelled "Front elevation", depicts a pale green rectangle labelled "Floor-mounted charge point" resting on a hatched floor line, flanked by two hatched vertical elements, with a single label "Wall/object" at the top above the right-hand one. The gaps either side are each labelled "Free space". Green dimension arrows above read "≥1500mm" from the left wall to the unit, "≥450mm" across the unit, and "≥1500mm" from the unit to the right wall. The right part, labelled "Side elevation", shows the same pale green rectangle labelled "Floor-mounted charge point" on the hatched floor, with one hatched vertical element to its left and the gap between them labelled "Free space". Green arrows above read "≥500mm" from the wall to the unit and "≥220mm" across the unit. A vertical green arrow to the right of the unit reads "≥1200mm", and on the right an arrow points to the hatched floor line with the label "floor".
